note: NOT DEPLOYED YET. BNB Chain mainnet (BNB Smart Chain): ShieldPoolPayments on the ceremony's final keys, born guarded like Elysium, with the 0.5% cash-out fee. To be deployed with script/DeployBnbMainnet.s.sol (DEPLOY-BNB.md); bnb-mainnet-after-deploy.sh replaces this file with what the chain reads back. Until then this file names no vault, so the deploy's redeploy check (script/RedeployGuard.sol) only checks the deployer's own nonces. Gas is paid in BNB.

plan.addressesNote: Where each lands if the deployer sends nothing else first: PoseidonT3 at nonce 0, the vault at nonce 8 (the same addresses as on Elysium), the guard at nonce 16, the memo board at nonce 21. The guard controller is the Gloam Owner Safe (2 of 3), replayed on BNB Chain at the same address first (DEPLOY-BNB.md step 1).

limitsNote: Planned launch limits, the policy live on Base on 2026-11-18: the stablecoins and the native coin with no limit (type(uint128).max), BDX capped at 100,000 per deposit and 2,000,000 in total. Each is computed from the token's decimals() by bnb-mainnet-env.sh.
